name: Wild boar
summary: Wild boar is one of the meats Gia Lai is known for. It is not the Sê San river fish that shares the sọc dưa name.
origin: The opening list of the 22 July 2022 river-food article.
howToEat: Order it as a Gia Lai meat. It is a different thing from the sọc dưa fish of the Sê San.
seoTitle: Heo sọc dưa — named in Gia Lai
seoDescription: Heo sọc dưa, wild boar, is one of the meats Gia Lai is known for. It is not the Sê San fish of the same name.
